question: Where is the subtle flame-crest absorbed according to this instruction?
premises: The flame-crest is the object of focus
It is absorbed in a specific location
That location is the bone wheel
inference: The flame-crest is absorbed there in the bone wheel, O beautiful-faced one.
uncertainties: Exact identification of asthi cakre depends on tantric anatomical context
plain_english: There indeed the flame-crest is absorbed in the bone wheel, O beautiful-faced one.
